Support tools I have 'written' in 2026

Nov 23, 2026

  • Draft created: Nov 23, 2026 22:15 (UTC). This post lists the tools that I have written in the thunderbird GitHub organization. Production is Y for tools that are ready for production use. The add-ons are not signed yet, so the links go to the unsigned add-on and to instructions for it. I have removed the private tools. The list was made on 2026-11-21 with tools_post.py (private repo link).
